name: Ippe A
source:
An adult om'veri with an elegant green appearance reminiscent of Eastern motifs. His body, neck, and long, flexible tail are covered in smooth scales of a deep, dark green color with a sleek, glossy sheen. Along the neck and head stretches a thick, lush mane of a bright grass-green shade, which frames the muzzle in thin strands, transitioning into long whiskers. The creature's head is adorned with two large, curved horns of a light beige or cream color, contrasting with the dark scales. The om'verai's large, almond-shaped eyes are of a rich purple color with an expressive gaze. A smooth, golden scarf is worn around the neck. Behind the back, webbed wings of the same dark green color as the scales are folded.
Ippe is proud of his native culture, including by receiving clients in the sauna at the "Il'potere del'verde" hotel.
